message.content: This is a screenshot of the **DexScreener** app (a cryptocurrency analytics platform) showing the Ginnancoin (GINNAN) token’s trading page. The interface displays a live price chart (with candlestick patterns), on - chain metrics (holders, DEX/CEX volume), and trading tabs (Trades, Positions, etc.). Prices appear live (e.g., the $120K price and +0.04% change), and the UI is in English (not Arabic).
